What verification establishes

The site compares the workbook with the instructor’s private issuance record. After verifying the checksum, question positions and attention-check image, Python grades the designated answer cells using the student’s protected data. The attention check is scored separately.

A match verifies the issued version. Enter the checksum you saved at issuance. A failed attention check can indicate that someone overlooked it.

New student workbooks contain no embedded grading map. Private grading records are saved on this device; clearing site storage removes them. To grade elsewhere, restore the private instructor archive on the generator page. Files and grades are processed in this browser.
